decisions.statement: The key keeps the place it had among the keys of its entry.
Every entry stating that key is respelled.
An entry stating no such key is passed over rather than refused.
A key inside a value an entry states is left as that key is.
The passage answered runs from the first entry respelled to the last rather than the body.
One passage is answered however many entries are respelled.
A body stating that key in no entry answers no edit rather than being refused.
A body whose entry states both the key held and the key asked for is refused.
A body that is no run of JSON objects is refused.
The body worked on is the body the world answers rather than the body on disk.

definition: one key of every entry beside a page spelled anew, keeping its place and its value
